name: Crossroad Combat (SHADOW, SENATOR, KNIGHT SONIC)
desc:
Welcome to Crossroad Combat! This is a game starring several different characters from a variety of franchises where you can either hang out with your friends or complete random quests. Play as characters from games and media around the world as you explore the entire map to find secrets, get cosmetic skins, and unlock more characters!

-Credit to the respective owners of each series (we didn't create any of them unless specified later)
OM0CAT, SEGA, PlatinumGames, Kojima Productions, Scott Cawthon, Toby Fox.
